findings.title: Preserve the light-theme contrast of embedded-post attribution
findings.body: The light-theme branch changes the embedded-post attribution link from 30% lightness scaling to 70%, rather than preserving the existing color. With a black primary color this changes approximately #4d4d4d to #b3b3b3, making the small attribution text substantially harder to read on a light background. Keep the light branch at 30% and use the corresponding 70% secondary scaling for the dark branch.

findings.title: Do not dim mobile topic-map headings in light themes
findings.body: The new light-theme branch scales the primary color by 50%, whereas the previous topic-map h3 heading used 20%. This unnecessarily reduces heading contrast in existing light themes and makes headings use the same muted color as the h4 metadata beneath them. Preserve the 20% light-theme value and use 80% secondary scaling for the dark-theme branch.
